target: Kita bertemu jam tujuh malam, ya?
english: We are meeting at seven tonight, okay?
grammar: jam + number tells the time: jam tujuh = seven o'clock; jam berapa? = what time?

target: Nanti malam kamu ada acara tidak?
english: Do you have any plans tonight?
grammar: nanti = later (today): nanti malam = tonight; nanti sore = later this afternoon.

target: Saya mau mengajak kamu makan malam.
english: I want to invite you to dinner.

target: Boleh saya menelepon kamu nanti sore?
english: May I call you later this afternoon?

target: Kirim pesan saja kalau kamu sudah tiba.
english: Just send a message when you have arrived.

target: Maaf, saya terlambat lima belas menit.
english: Sorry, I am fifteen minutes late.

target: Jadi kita ketemu di mana besok?
english: So where are we meeting tomorrow?
grammar: ketemu is the everyday spoken form of bertemu: ketemu jam lima = meet at five.

target: Maaf, rencana kita tidak jadi, ya.
english: Sorry, our plan is not happening after all.
grammar: tidak jadi = (a plan) falls through: Piknik tidak jadi = the picnic is off.

target: Saya ada janji dengan dokter gigi.
english: I have an appointment with the dentist.
grammar: janji = promise or appointment: ada janji = to have an appointment.

target: Dia tidak mengangkat telepon saya tadi.
english: She did not answer my call earlier.

target: Boleh saya minta nomor telepon kamu?
english: May I have your phone number?
grammar: boleh = may (permission): Boleh saya minta nomornya? = may I have the number?

target: Saya akan menelepon kantor itu besok pagi.
english: I will call that office tomorrow morning.

target: Kami berjanji bertemu di depan bioskop.
english: We promised to meet in front of the cinema.

target: Kamu bisa datang jam berapa nanti?
english: What time can you come later?

target: Ayo kita menonton film hari Sabtu ini.
english: Come on, let's watch a movie this Saturday.
grammar: ayo = come on, let's: Ayo kita makan = let's eat.

target: Saya sibuk hari Senin, bagaimana hari Selasa?
english: I am busy on Monday, how about Tuesday?

target: Baik, sampai nanti di kafe ya.
english: Alright, see you later at the cafe.
grammar: sampai nanti = see you later (lit. until later); sampai jumpa = see you.

target: Dia mengirim pesan tapi saya belum membalas.
english: He sent a message but I have not replied yet.

target: Tolong telepon saya kalau kamu tidak bisa datang.
english: Please call me if you cannot come.

target: Kita jadi pergi ke pantai hari Minggu?
english: Are we still going to the beach on Sunday?
grammar: jadi checks a plan is still on: Jadi pergi? = are we still going?

target: Saya lupa menelepon ibu saya kemarin.
english: I forgot to call my mother yesterday.

target: Jangan lupa janji kita jam dua siang.
english: Do not forget our appointment at two in the afternoon.

target: Rapat besok tidak jadi karena bos sakit.
english: Tomorrow's meeting is off because the boss is sick.

target: Dia menelepon saya tiga kali tadi malam.
english: She called me three times last night.

target: Kapan kamu ada waktu minggu ini?
english: When do you have time this week?

target: Saya mengirim alamat hotelnya lewat pesan, ya.
english: I will send the hotel's address by message, okay.
grammar: -nya can mean 'the': hotelnya = the hotel; kuncinya = the key.

target: Kami akan berkumpul di rumah nenek hari Minggu.
english: We will gather at grandma's house on Sunday.

target: Mereka mengundang kami ke pesta pernikahan.
english: They invited us to a wedding party.

target: Tunggu sebentar, ada telepon masuk.
english: Wait a moment, there is an incoming call.

target: Saya berangkat sekarang, tunggu saya di lobi.
english: I am leaving now, wait for me in the lobby.

target: Maaf, tadi saya tidak mendengar telepon kamu.
english: Sorry, I did not hear your call earlier.

target: Bagaimana kalau kita bertemu jam sepuluh saja?
english: How about we meet at ten instead?
grammar: saja softens suggestions: jam sepuluh saja = let's just make it ten.

target: Acara mulai jam delapan, jangan terlambat ya.
english: The event starts at eight, do not be late.
grammar: jangan = do not: Jangan terlambat! = don't be late!

target: Saya sedang menunggu balasan pesan dari dia.
english: I am waiting for a message reply from him.

target: Kamu mau ikut kami ke konser besok malam?
english: Do you want to come with us to the concert tomorrow night?

target: Nanti saya menjemput kamu di stasiun kereta.
english: I will pick you up at the train station later.

target: Dia berjanji datang tapi tidak muncul.
english: He promised to come but did not show up.

target: Telepon dari kantor itu penting sekali.
english: That call from the office is very important.

target: Kita makan siang bersama hari Kamis, bisa?
english: Can we have lunch together on Thursday?

target: Saya harus membatalkan janji kita sore ini.
english: I have to cancel our appointment this afternoon.
grammar: membatalkan = to cancel (root batal): membatalkan janji = cancel an appointment.

target: Jam berapa pesawat kamu tiba besok?
english: What time does your plane arrive tomorrow?

target: Saya menelepon hotel untuk mengubah pesanan kamar.
english: I called the hotel to change the room booking.

target: Kalau tidak jadi hujan, kita jalan-jalan sore.
english: If it does not end up raining, we will take a walk in the late afternoon.

target: Sinyal di sini jelek, saya akan menelepon lagi.
english: The signal here is bad, I will call again.

target: Dia selalu sibuk, susah sekali ditelepon.
english: He is always busy, very hard to reach by phone.
grammar: di- makes a verb passive: ditelepon = to be called; ditunggu = to be waited for.

target: Akhirnya kita bisa bertemu lagi minggu depan.
english: Finally we can meet again next week.

target: Tolong ingatkan saya soal rapat besok pagi.
english: Please remind me about tomorrow morning's meeting.

target: Ponsel saya mati, jadi saya meminjam telepon teman.
english: My phone died, so I borrowed a friend's phone.

target: Kita bertemu di depan pintu masuk mal, ya.
english: We will meet in front of the mall entrance, okay.

target: Senang sekali akhirnya bisa bertemu kamu lagi.
english: So happy to finally be able to see you again.

target: Rumah kami punya tiga kamar tidur.
english: Our house has three bedrooms.

target: Kamar mandi ada di lantai dua.
english: The bathroom is on the second floor.
grammar: lantai dua = the second floor: storeys use plain numbers after lantai.

target: Ibu sedang membersihkan dapur sekarang.
english: Mom is cleaning the kitchen right now.

target: Mobil merah itu punya tetangga kami.
english: That red car belongs to our neighbor.
grammar: Adjectives follow the noun: mobil merah = red car (lit. car red).

target: Saya suka memakai baju biru ke kantor.
english: I like wearing blue clothes to the office.
grammar: memakai = to wear or use: memakai baju biru = wear a blue shirt.

target: Lemari di kamar saya sudah penuh.
english: The wardrobe in my room is already full.

target: Kunci rumah ada di dalam laci meja.
english: The house key is in the desk drawer.

target: Dinding ruang tamu kami putih bersih.
english: Our living room walls are a clean white.

target: Adik memilih sepatu hitam untuk sekolah.
english: My little sibling chose black shoes for school.

target: Jendela kamar saya menghadap ke taman.
english: My bedroom window faces the garden.

target: Tolong tutup pintu dapur itu, ya.
english: Please close that kitchen door, okay.

target: Kami menaruh sofa baru di ruang tamu.
english: We put the new sofa in the living room.

target: Warna apa yang paling kamu suka?
english: What color do you like the most?
grammar: paling = the most: paling suka = like best; paling besar = the biggest.

target: Saya membeli gorden kuning untuk kamar anak.
english: I bought yellow curtains for the child's room.

target: Kulkas kami rusak sejak kemarin sore.
english: Our fridge has been broken since yesterday afternoon.

target: Dia memakai jaket hijau dan topi putih.
english: He is wearing a green jacket and a white hat.

target: Lampu di kamar mandi tidak menyala.
english: The light in the bathroom does not turn on.

target: Tolong nyalakan lampu ruang tamu, sudah gelap.
english: Please turn on the living room light, it is dark already.
grammar: -kan turns a state into an action: menyala = be on, nyalakan = turn it on.

target: Jangan lupa mematikan kompor sebelum pergi.
english: Do not forget to turn off the stove before leaving.
grammar: mematikan = to turn off (lit. make dead): mematikan lampu = turn off the light.

target: Handuk bersih ada di lemari kamar mandi.
english: Clean towels are in the bathroom cupboard.

target: Celana hitam itu terlalu panjang untuk saya.
english: Those black trousers are too long for me.
grammar: terlalu = too (excessive): terlalu panjang = too long; terlalu mahal = too expensive.

target: Saya menyimpan paspor di dalam tas biru.
english: I keep my passport inside the blue bag.

target: Halaman belakang rumah nenek luas sekali.
english: Grandma's backyard is very spacious.

target: Kaus kaki saya hilang satu di kamar.
english: One of my socks is missing in the room.

target: Kemeja putih ini cocok dengan celana biru.
english: This white shirt goes well with blue trousers.
grammar: cocok = to match or suit: cocok dengan = goes well with.

target: Kami makan malam di meja kayu yang besar.
english: We have dinner at the big wooden table.
grammar: yang picks out 'the ... one': meja yang besar = the big table.

target: Ada cermin besar di dekat pintu kamar.
english: There is a big mirror near the bedroom door.

target: Ayah sedang mengecat pagar dengan warna hijau.
english: Dad is painting the fence green.

target: Karpet ruang tamu kami merah tua.
english: Our living room carpet is dark red.
grammar: tua darkens a color, muda lightens it: merah tua = dark red; biru muda = light blue.

target: Saya mencuci piring dan gelas setelah makan.
english: I wash the plates and glasses after eating.

target: Baju kuning muda itu bagus untuk pesta.
english: That light yellow dress is nice for a party.

target: Kamar hotel kami menghadap ke kolam renang.
english: Our hotel room faces the swimming pool.

target: Tas hijau di kursi itu punya siapa?
english: Whose green bag is that on the chair?
grammar: punya siapa? = whose?: Tas ini punya siapa? = whose bag is this?

target: Dapur rumah baru kami kecil tapi bersih.
english: The kitchen of our new house is small but clean.

target: Dia mengganti seprai tempat tidur setiap minggu.
english: She changes the bed sheets every week.

target: Sepatu putih saya kotor karena hujan kemarin.
english: My white shoes are dirty because of the rain yesterday.

target: Di garasi ada dua sepeda dan satu mobil.
english: There are two bicycles and one car in the garage.
grammar: ada = there is/are: Di garasi ada sepeda = there is a bicycle in the garage.

target: Saya lebih suka warna biru daripada merah.
english: I prefer blue to red.
grammar: lebih ... daripada = more ... than: lebih suka biru daripada merah = prefer blue to red.

target: Anak-anak menggambar di lantai kamar mereka.
english: The children are drawing on the floor of their room.

target: Jaket hitam itu tergantung di belakang pintu.
english: That black jacket is hanging behind the door.
grammar: ter- describes a state: tergantung = hanging; tertutup = closed.

target: Kami memasang gorden baru di jendela dapur.
english: We put up new curtains on the kitchen window.

target: Bantal dan selimut ada di atas tempat tidur.
english: The pillow and blanket are on top of the bed.

target: Rok merah itu terlihat bagus untuk kamu.
english: That red skirt looks good on you.

target: Ibu menyapu lantai dapur setiap pagi.
english: Mom sweeps the kitchen floor every morning.
grammar: setiap = every: setiap pagi = every morning; setiap hari = every day.

target: Rumah putih di ujung jalan itu milik paman saya.
english: The white house at the end of the street belongs to my uncle.

target: Saya perlu membeli sabun dan sampo baru.
english: I need to buy new soap and shampoo.

target: Topi biru tua ini hadiah dari kakak.
english: This dark blue hat is a gift from my older sibling.

target: Mereka memindahkan lemari besar itu ke gudang.
english: They moved that big wardrobe to the storeroom.

target: Dinding kamar anak kami biru muda.
english: Our child's bedroom walls are light blue.

target: Setiap warna di rumah ini punya cerita.
english: Every color in this house has a story.
